notes.puzzle.title: The puzzle slice's menu: two falling-piece games (and VERSUS with two players).
notes.puzzle.menu.pairs: The second game: falling pairs of coloured blobs (Puyo Puyo).
notes.puzzle.menu.versus: Two players, each a field, side by side (it joins the menu once a second player is in).
notes.puzzle.menu.other: After a game: play the other one of the two.
notes.puzzle.menu.title: Back to the title.
notes.puzzle.menu.rematch: After a versus game: the same two players again.
notes.puzzle.how.touch: The menu's help on a touch screen: four hints three spaces apart (drag sideways to move, tap to turn the piece, flick down to drop it, flick up to put it on hold).
notes.puzzle.how.keys: The same on a keyboard (shown in capitals): the arrow keys move; up or {key:rotate} turns the piece; {key:drop} drops it; {key:hold} holds it.
notes.puzzle.how.player: With two players, each one's keys: {player} (P1, P2), {move} how they move (ARROWS, WASD or a STICK), then the keys {rotate}, {drop}, {hold} each before what it does.
notes.puzzle.how.arrows: The arrow keys (the keyboard's right half moves player 2).
notes.puzzle.how.wasd: The W, A, S and D keys (the keyboard's left half): keep as written.
notes.puzzle.hold: Over the piece on hold (put aside to use later).
notes.puzzle.chain: A chain of pops in the pairs game: {chain} pops in a row, each set off by the one before.
notes.puzzle.vs.player: Player {n} (1 or 2), short, over a versus field and in the help.
notes.action.rotate: Turn the piece clockwise (on the controls screen).
notes.action.drop: Drop the piece at once (a hard drop).
notes.action.hold: Put the piece on hold, or take back the one held.

brief: The puzzle slice: two falling-piece games on one neon stage, BLOCKS (after Tetris) and PAIRS (after Puyo Puyo), and VERSUS for two players. Short arcade capitals beside the playing field. The player is unseen.
